seoTitle: Content Brief Builder from Competitor Headings
metaDescription: Paste headings of top-ranking pages and get a content brief: shared topics, questions, common terms, outline length and a draft outline.
intro: Turns the headings of competing pages into a brief: topics most pages cover, questions asked, common terms and a draft outline for your own page.
why:
Writers often start from an empty page. Seeing what the top pages cover, and which questions they answer, gives a starting outline in minutes.

Paste each competitor's headings (Markdown, HTML or lines like H2: Title) and separate pages with a line of three equal signs. Topics are grouped by shared words in the headings, so check the groups. A brief shows what others cover. It cannot tell you what will rank or what your own angle should be.
howTo: Type the target keyword in the first box.
Paste the headings of each competitor page, separated by ===.
Read the topics, questions and terms.
Edit the draft outline and add your own expertise.

faq.q: How do I get headings from a page?
faq.a: View the page source or use a heading extractor, then paste the h1 to h4 lines. Markdown # headings also work.

faq.q: How many pages should I use?
faq.a: Three to ten of the top results is enough.
It only counts topics. Write your own text and add information they do not have.
